`CONTRIBUTING.md`:

```md
# Contributing to RootAtlas

RootAtlas is an independent module **index**, not a binary hosting service.
New sources, bug fixes and responsible metadata improvements are welcome.

## Propose a repository

Open an issue with the feed's public HTTPS URL and the original publisher's
GitHub project. For MMRL, it must serve `json/modules.json` in the
MMRL schema. For KernelSU Next, it must serve a top-level `modules.json`
array of GitHub repositories with valid names, authors and descriptions.
A repository should be actively maintained and have real, installable
module releases. Do not submit mirrors of the RootAtlas feed itself.

Automatic GitHub discovery is best-effort and will not find every third-party
host or privately distributed source. See
[`sources/federation.json`](sources/federation.json) for curated additions.

## Integrity and source policy

- Links are original developer-hosted resources; never submit modified,
  repacked or unauthorized APKs/ZIPs.
- A valid `module.prop` or JSON format does **not** make a module safe.
- The maintainer may reject stale, cloned, misleading or dangerous sources.
- Independent discovered feeds may **add** IDs, but cannot replace modules
  already supplied by established sources.
- Do not advertise root-hiding, bypass, compatibility or security as tested
  unless directly supported by reproducible evidence.
- Keep LSPosed/Xposed APK projects out of MMRL and KernelSU Next flashable
  ZIP feeds. See [the architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Development

Test with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. The GitHub Actions job
renders the banner, refreshes sources, validates all manager contracts, and
publishes generated JSON only on success.

Changes to generated JSON alone will be overwritten on the next run.
Update the source parser, discovery rules or curated source configuration.

No Android device is required to contribute; RootAtlas does not install
modules or run a phone-resident daemon.

## Credits and license

The indexer source code is [MIT licensed](LICENSE). Every original module,
catalog, feed and referenced binary retains its **own** publisher,
copyright and license. RootAtlas does not grant permission to rehost them.

```

<div align="center">

<img src="assets/root-feed-banner.jpg" alt="RootAtlas — a luminous modular cube linking Android root module repositories" width="100%" />

<h1>RootAtlas</h1>

<h3>The federated index for Android root modules.</h3>

<p>Find more Android modules without adding dozens of repos. RootAtlas combines MMRL feeds, KernelSU Next manifests, independently discovered GitHub repositories, and the complete <strong><a href="https://krishna3163.github.io/best-root-apps-for-android/">Best Root Apps for Android</a></strong> discovery catalog, with automatic daily updates.</p>

## 📦 Add to MMRL

In **MMRL → Repos → +**, paste this **base URL** (including the trailing slash):

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge/main/
```

MMRL reads our [unified module index](json/modules.json) and displays both inspected Best Root Apps releases and modules from other curated MMRL repositories. The banner above also appears in MMRL's repository card.

## ⚡ Add to KernelSU Next

In **KernelSU Next → Module Repository → Manage Repositories → Add**, paste this **JSON file URL**:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge/main/ksu/modules.json
```

KernelSU Next uses a different format. This feed merges our inspected single-ZIP sources with the official KernelSU Next open-source and metamodule manifests. The manager fetches each upstream repository's release when you select a module.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The **MMRL URL is a folder**, while the **KernelSU Next URL is a JSON file**. The two are not interchangeable.

## ✨ What's inside?

| | Collection | What you'll find |
|:--:|---|---|
| 🧭 | **[Best Root Apps catalog](discovery.json)** | Original upstream entries, including root apps, Shizuku tools, LSPosed utilities, GitLab, Codeberg, Play Store links, and Morphe patched APKs |
| 📦 | **[MMRL modules](json/modules.json)** | Combined index from our inspected catalog and other MMRL repository feeds; duplicates resolved by module ID |
| ⚡ | **[KernelSU Next modules](ksu/modules.json)** | Our inspected sources plus official KernelSU Next open-source and metamodule manifests, deduped by repository |
| 📈 | **[Live coverage report](report.json)** | Exact discovery counts, successful module inspections, exclusions, and scan progress |

## 🔄 How it works

```text
Best Root Apps ──────┐
MMRL directory ──────┤
Curated MMRL feeds ──┤
GitHub repo discovery┤ → validate → merge → deduplicate
KernelSU manifests ──┘                   |
                           ┌─────────────┴───────────┐
                           |                         |
                       MMRL JSON             KernelSU Next JSON
                           |                         |
                           └── daily GitHub Actions ─┘
```

- **Daily updates:** GitHub Actions refreshes around **18:17 JST**, including newly registered MMRL sources and previously discovered repositories.
- **Independent GitHub discovery:** bounded repository searches check public `modules.json` and `json/modules.json` for valid manager-specific entries; candidates that fail validation are excluded.
- **Different safety tiers:** upstream feeds supply module metadata; RootAtlas does not audit every external ZIP or guarantee compatibility.
- **Your existing sources:** We started with the repository URLs recovered from your MMRL app, plus official discovery feeds. Your phone does **not** need to remain connected.
- **One source, one record:** MMRL deduplicates by module ID; KernelSU Next deduplicates by GitHub source repository.
- **Failure protection:** Broken JSON, missing required timestamps and failed feeds cannot invalidate the combined repository. Previously successful upstream data is cached.
- **No rehosting or automatic flashing:** Developer downloads stay upstream and nothing is installed on your phone.

**Different verification levels:** Best Root Apps ZIPs are downloaded and structurally inspected for `module.prop`. Other MMRL repositories are checked for valid JSON and required fields, **not** independently audited ZIP-by-ZIP. The official KernelSU Next manifests are sourced from their maintainers. No feed entry guarantees security, compatibility or successful installation.

### 📡 Upstream sources and transparency

- **[Configured repositories](sources/federation.json):** the curated starting sources, MMRL directory, and KernelSU Next manifests.
- **[Discovered repositories](source-discovery-state.json):** independent GitHub feeds found through scheduled searches, with public source URLs and inspection timestamps.
- **[Coverage and source-health report](report.json):** live counts, successful feeds, failed feeds, and filtered entries.
- **[Module provenance](federation-provenance.json):** records which catalog or repository supplied each displayed module.
- **[Processing architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):** merge rules, caching, validation and limitations.

The MMRL app and KernelSU Next require **different JSON schemas**. The two import URLs above remain separate, but each is a unified repository for its manager.

<details>
<summary><strong>🔧 Maintainer information, validation and troubleshooting</strong></summary>

The repository is intentionally small and serverless.

- [Current automation status](https://github.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge/actions/workflows/update.yml)
- [Coverage and exclusion reasons](report.json)
- [Architecture, data boundaries and update policy](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [MMRL JSON output](json/modules.json) · [KernelSU Next JSON output](ksu/modules.json)
- [Updater source](scripts/update.py) · [Validation source](scripts/validate.py)
- [Original source catalog](https://github.com/krishna3163/best-root-apps-for-android)

To refresh manually, open **Actions → Update Root Module Feeds → Run workflow**. If MMRL shows an older count or banner, tap **Update** on the repository card. GitHub may occasionally delay scheduled actions; the repository is intended to be hands-off, not guaranteed to require zero maintenance forever.

</details>

## 🧩 Xposed and LSPosed

RootAtlas deliberately does **not** turn Xposed/LSPosed APKs into
Magisk/KernelSU flashable modules. That ecosystem already has a dedicated
and actively updated [official Xposed Module Repository](https://modules.lsposed.org/)
and a separate [community Xposed directory](https://github.com/rushiranpise/xposed-modules).
Use those for APK-based modules; the two RootAtlas feeds remain for root ZIPs.

## 🤝 Open-source and contributions

RootAtlas's original indexer code is [MIT licensed](LICENSE). Original
module authors retain ownership and licensing of their binaries and metadata.
To propose missing sources, report a broken feed or improve the pipeline, see
[Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the
[technical architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`:

```md
# RootAtlas — architecture, provenance and operational policy

## Independent source discovery

`scripts/source_discovery.py` also searches public GitHub **repositories** every
daily run, rather than trusting a fixed list of URLs. Eight bounded GitHub
repository-search requests rotate broad queries, and up to 96 eligible
repositories are probed per execution. A repository is accepted only after its
public `json/modules.json` (MMRL) or `modules.json` (KernelSU Next) passes
schema checks and includes real, valid records. Results are saved in
[`source-discovery-state.json`](../source-discovery-state.json), including
negative responses and last-check dates. Negative candidates can be retried
after 14 days. A temporary GitHub search failure retains previous discoveries.

Search results are **not** proof of a safe module. We exclude our own feed to
prevent recursion, and skip templates, demos, examples, and empty repositories.
An auto-discovered module ID can **never override** one already supplied by
the established catalog or curated sources, even if it advertises an inflated
version code. Competing sources and their origins remain auditable.

GitHub searches are bounded, do not cover every host, may miss repositories,
and respect the platform's rate limits. This is a continuously expanding index,
**not** a verified claim to index every root-related repository in existence.

## Why Xposed/LSPosed is separate

The official [Xposed Module Repository](https://modules.lsposed.org/) already
indexes Xposed/LSPosed APKs, and
[the community Xposed directory](https://github.com/rushiranpise/xposed-modules)
also updates automatically. APK artifacts should not appear as installable
Magisk/KernelSU ZIP modules. RootAtlas links to these resources but deliberately
does not merge their APKs into MMRL/KernelSU Next feeds. A distinct, clearly
labeled Xposed-only JSON could be considered without conflating install formats.

## Federated repository sources (November 2026)

The unified importer lives in `scripts/federation.py`, with curated sources in
[`sources/federation.json`](../sources/federation.json). The seed list combines
the MMRL repository URLs recovered (read-only) from the owner's Android MMRL
database, known public MMRL indexes, and the
[official MMRL discovery directory](https://github.com/MMRLApp/Discovery/blob/main/json/remotes.json).
The directory is fetched daily, so new official listings can be discovered
without updating our configuration.

KernelSU Next imports the official open-source `modules.json` and
`meta_modules.json`. Its separate `non_free_modules.json` is deliberately
configured **disabled**, preserving the manager's normal opt-in distinction.

MMRL and KernelSU Next consume fundamentally different formats. They have
different import URLs, but each URL combines the eligible sources for that
manager.

### Data flow and trust boundaries

```text
Best Root Apps README + GitHub Releases -> static ZIP inspection -+
                                                                  |
Public MMRL directory + saved MMRL feeds -> schema validation ----+-> MMRL index
                                                                  |
Official KSU Next OSS + metamodule manifests -> schema validation +-> KSU index
```

External MMRL modules must have typed IDs, authors, supported track types,
version codes in Kotlin's Int range, valid HTTPS ZIP URLs, and **real numeric
timestamps on every published version**. Invalid versions are removed; modules
with no valid versions are excluded. Missing timestamps are never invented.

Duplicate MMRL IDs resolve deterministically: the inspected catalog
establishes the baseline; curated upstream repositories can supersede it with
a higher `versionCode` (then newer release timestamp). Uncurated
auto-discovered repositories are **additions only** and cannot supersede any
existing ID. Distinct sources and collisions are recorded in
[`federation-provenance.json`](../federation-provenance.json). KernelSU Next
deduplicates by canonical GitHub `repoUrl`; upstream banners and licenses can
enrich an existing entry without introducing a duplicate.

Source failures preserve last-successful normalized entries in
[`federation-state.json`](../federation-state.json). Failed sources without
cached data are skipped rather than publishing malformed entries. When the
official directory is unreachable, the curated seed list remains usable.
The [live report](../report.json) includes the number of feeds fetched,
failures and excluded malformed modules.

**Security distinction:** Our Best Root Apps ZIPs undergo static module.prop
archive inspection, but imported MMRL feeds undergo *schema validation only*.
Their referenced ZIP archives are **not** independently downloaded, inspected,
or trusted by federation. Official KernelSU Next manifests are imported as
published (and may use their own compatibility requirements). This project
does not claim the resulting ZIPs are safe to install, nor does it modify the
Android system.

Only curated MMRL seeds and the official MMRL discovery directory are ingested,
not arbitrary web search results. The goal is a broad, maintainable catalog,
not a claim to have indexed every root module in existence.

---

## Goal and completion criteria

Mirror **all catalog metadata** published by [Best Root Apps for Android](https://krishna3163.github.io/best-root-apps-for-android/) while publishing only **inspected, installable root module ZIPs** to MMRL and KernelSU Next. The original author owns all source entries, downloads and licenses. We maintain indexes only.

Acceptance conditions:

1. Include every upstream README app row, its original link, labels, category, and description. Include upstream Morphe release metadata (discovery only) and any configured release trackers not already listed.
2. Maintain independent, correctly shaped MMRL and KernelSU Next feeds.
3. Query every distinct GitHub source repository and eventually reach zero unchecked GitHub repositories without requiring manual curation.
4. Update on a daily schedule, checking previously valid releases first and newly discovered sources before rescanning old negative results.
5. Block publication if sources disappear unexpectedly, the valid module count collapses, outputs are malformed, or unit/contract tests fail.
6. Never mirror, execute, repack, install, or auto-flash downloaded releases.

## Source-of-truth boundaries

- **Upstream README**: canonical list of projects, parsed with the exact bold-table-row pattern used in the upstream `scripts/readme.py`. It can be fresher than the GitHub Pages website.
- **Upstream `data/morphe-releases.json`**: additional patched APK entries, never root modules.
- **Upstream `config/apps.json`**: explicitly tracked release projects.
- **GitHub REST /repos/OWNER/REPO/releases/latest**: authoritative current release assets for a discovered GitHub project.
- **Release ZIP**: inspected statically; a root-level `module.prop` with valid ID, version and numeric versionCode is required.
- **Local `state.json`**: cached last-good module metadata and release ID, not a source of ownership or trust.

Providers outside GitHub (GitLab, Codeberg, Play Store, official sites) are included in discovery. They are *not* silently converted into GitHub repos or flashable modules.

## Outputs

| Path | Consumer | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `discovery.json` | General browsing, tooling | Complete item array with original URLs, provider, category, framework badges, provenance, and Morphe metadata |
| `report.json` | Audit / diagnostics | Coverage totals, scan progress, exclusions and module counts |
| `state.json` | Updater only | Cached release inspections keyed by canonical GitHub owner/repo |
| `json/modules.json` | MMRL | Object with name, metadata (version 1, epoch float), modules array, version metadata, selected ZIP |
| `json/config.json` | Repository compatibility | Name and website metadata |
| `ksu/modules.json` | KernelSU Next | Array with name, author, description, repoUrl and visibility |

Paste into MMRL (base directory):
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge/main/`

Paste into KernelSU Next (JSON file):
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge/main/ksu/modules.json`

## Installation boundary

The release ZIP must be HTTPS from GitHub's official releases and have `module.prop` at the ZIP root. The archive has a 96 MiB cap; the metadata file is limited to 16 KiB. No archive member is extracted or executed. A ZIP with invalid module.prop, no release, too many entries, or ambiguous multiple module IDs is **not** listed as installable. This is a packaging check **not** a safety, compatibility, authenticity, or root-hiding guarantee.

MMRL displays only one version per distinct module ID, selecting the most recently published inspected release if forks collide. KernelSU Next works differently: its manager fetches a repository's latest GitHub release and blindly selects the first ZIP asset. The KernelSU feed therefore includes only inspected releases with **exactly one ZIP**, but it can include multiple distinct source repos sharing a module ID.

Downloaded release assets can be linked to a different GitHub repository than the catalog source if that's the location returned by the source repository's GitHub Releases API. Cross-repository assets remain original developer-hosted assets; these should be individually reviewed before flashing.

**Nothing is installed on your Android device automatically.** Root and Zygisk compatibility must be checked by the user before flashing. Device-specific modules can be dangerous.

## Update and failure policy

The [GitHub Actions updater](../.github/workflows/update.yml) runs every day at 09:17 UTC (18:17 JST), and on source/test/workflow changes. New sources and all previously validated sources are checked first. Rejected sources are retried after 48 hours. Checks are bounded and run in parallel with a limit of eight workers. GitHub API errors preserve previous inspected data; no successful scan means no blank publication. Failure of any test, 25%+ source shrink, 25%+ verified module collapse, or malformed JSON aborts before commit. Generated data commits to `main` only after tests and validation pass.

GitHub may delay or suspend scheduled workflows and provider formats or rate limits may change. No upkeep is normally required, but permanent maintenance-free operation cannot be guaranteed.

## Operational verification

View [workflow runs](https://github.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge/actions/workflows/update.yml) and [live coverage report](../report.json). Both installation indexes are validated in CI, but **real-device import and installation remain separate acceptance tests**.

Manual rerun: GitHub → Actions → Update RootAtlas Module Feeds → Run workflow.

`scripts/banner.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render the Root Feed Bridge's GitHub-hosted 2:1 MMRL banner.

This is a deterministic image asset, not an application dependency.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import random
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter, ImageFont

WIDTH, HEIGHT = 1280, 625
OUTPUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "assets" / "root-feed-banner.jpg"
SEED = 310283


def bounded(x: float) -> int:
    return max(0, min(255, round(x)))


def polygon(draw, coords, color, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.polygon(coords, fill=color)
    if outline:
        draw.line(list(coords) + [coords[0]], fill=outline, width=width, joint="curve")


def main():
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    img = Image.new("RGB", (WIDTH, HEIGHT), (3, 10, 23))
    p = img.load()
    for y in range(HEIGHT):
        for x in range(WIDTH):
            dist = ((x - WIDTH * .51) ** 2 / (WIDTH * .58) ** 2 +
                    (y - HEIGHT * .46) ** 2 / (HEIGHT * .64) ** 2)
            central = math.exp(-dist * 2.9)
            teal = math.exp(-((x - 360) / 720) ** 2 - ((y - 420) / 540) ** 2)
            indigo = math.exp(-((x - 1030) / 550) ** 2 - ((y - 270) / 510) ** 2)
            grain = rng.randrange(-3, 4)
            p[x, y] = (
                bounded(5 + 9 * central + 6 * indigo + grain),
                bounded(11 + 19 * central + 14 * teal + grain),
                bounded(27 + 31 * central + 21 * indigo + grain),
            )

    # The large soft halo gives the modular core depth without flattening it.
    bloom = Image.new("RGBA", img.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    bd = ImageDraw.Draw(bloom, "RGBA")
    for r in range(270, 10, -6):
        strength = int((1 - r / 280) * 5 + 1)
        bd.ellipse((650 - r * 1.1, 269 - r * .73,
                    650 + r * 1.1, 269 + r * .73),
                   fill=(20, 210, 240, strength))
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img.convert("RGBA"), bloom.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(27)))

    # Perspective grid, tracks, and flecks of light.
    bg = Image.new("RGBA", img.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(bg, "RGBA")
    for i in range(30):
        shift = (i - 15) * 105
        d.line([(630, 380), (630 + shift, HEIGHT)], fill=(29, 132, 178, 29), width=1)
    for y in range(415, HEIGHT, 25):
        d.line([(0, y), (WIDTH, y)], fill=(15, 132, 154, 24), width=1)
    for _ in range(125):
        x, y = rng.randrange(WIDTH), rng.randrange(HEIGHT)
        strength = rng.randrange(15, 78)
        d.ellipse([x, y, x + 1.5, y + 1.5], fill=(76, 211, 242, strength))
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, bg)

    # Energy waves crossing behind the central cube.
    wave = Image.new("RGBA", img.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    wd = ImageDraw.Draw(wave, "RGBA")
    for track in range(9):
        yy = 275 + track * 13
        pts = [
            (x, yy + math.sin(x * .013 + track * .14) * (41 + track * 2)
             + (x - WIDTH / 2) ** 2 / 7500 * math.sin(track + .3))
            for x in range(-15, WIDTH + 25, 6)
        ]
        tone = (40, 236, 243, 150) if track % 3 else (158, 69, 249, 133)
        wd.line(pts, fill=tone, width=2, joint="curve")
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, wave.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(15)))
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, wave)

    # Embossed motherboard platforms in the foreground.
    platform = Image.new("RGBA", img.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    pd = ImageDraw.Draw(platform, "RGBA")
    for i in range(26):
        x = rng.randrange(-80, WIDTH + 10)
        y = rng.randrange(390, HEIGHT + 60)
        size = rng.randrange(70, 210)
        corners = [(x - size, y), (x - size * .32, y - 36),
                   (x + size * .87, y - 25), (x + size * .22, y + 22)]
        polygon(pd, corners, (11, 22, 39, 160), (65, 111, 140, 52), 2)
    for _ in range(90):
        x, y = rng.randrange(WIDTH), rng.randrange(420, HEIGHT)
        dx, dy = rng.randrange(15, 135), rng.choice((-28, 0, 28))
        col = (26, 236, 242, rng.randrange(30, 120))
        pd.line([(x, y), (x + dx * .45, y + dy),
                 (x + dx, y + dy)], fill=col, width=rng.choice([1, 2]))
        pd.ellipse((x + dx - 2, y + dy - 2, x + dx + 2, y + dy + 2), fill=col)
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, platform)

    # A floating isometric cube: metallic shell, luminous inner chamber,
    # and negative space in its front faces.
    cube = Image.new("RGBA", img.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    cd = ImageDraw.Draw(cube, "RGBA")
    cx, cy, rx, ry = 635, 275, 185, 109
    top = [(cx, cy - ry - 100), (cx + rx, cy - ry),
           (cx, cy - 15), (cx - rx, cy - ry)]
    left = [(cx - rx, cy - ry), (cx, cy - 15),
            (cx, cy + ry + 105), (cx - rx, cy + 16)]
    right = [(cx, cy - 15), (cx + rx, cy - ry),
             (cx + rx, cy + 16), (cx, cy + ry + 105)]
    polygon(cd, top, (44, 57, 79, 253), (112, 170, 193, 230), 4)
    polygon(cd, left, (18, 30, 51, 245), (28, 227, 230, 233), 4)
    polygon(cd, right, (27, 37, 63, 248), (124, 118, 244, 206), 4)
    # Hollow windows convey modularity.
    polygon(cd, [(cx - 152, cy - 64), (cx - 21, cy + 7),
                 (cx - 21, cy + 168), (cx - 152, cy + 91)],
            (3, 33, 54, 242), (47, 242, 243, 240), 5)
    polygon(cd, [(cx + 21, cy + 7), (cx + 152, cy - 64),
                 (cx + 152, cy + 91), (cx + 21, cy + 168)],
            (4, 34, 64, 239), (59, 222, 246, 232), 5)
    polygon(cd, [(cx - 125, cy - ry - 7), (cx, cy - ry - 80),
                 (cx + 125, cy - ry - 7), (cx, cy - 38)],
            (10, 36, 65, 250), (50, 238, 250, 235), 5)
    # Glowing inner power core, with extruded 3D faces.
    polygon(cd, [(cx, cy - 48), (cx + 75, cy - 10),
                 (cx, cy + 30), (cx - 75, cy - 10)],
            (31, 235, 251, 195), (144, 255, 254, 235), 3)
    polygon(cd, [(cx - 75, cy - 10), (cx, cy + 30),
                 (cx, cy + 119), (cx - 75, cy + 77)],
            (9, 138, 206, 200), (109, 251, 247, 235), 3)
    polygon(cd, [(cx, cy + 30), (cx + 75, cy - 10),
                 (cx + 75, cy + 77), (cx, cy + 119)],
            (29, 225, 226, 205), (114, 255, 250, 245), 3)
    # Glossy segmented cube corners.
    for x, y in [(cx-rx, cy-ry), (cx+rx, cy-ry),
                 (cx-rx, cy+16), (cx+rx, cy+16)]:
        cd.line([(x-7, y-7), (x+9, y+9)], fill=(187, 241, 246, 200), width=3)
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, cube.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(16)))
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, cube)

    # The levitating pedestal and underglow.
    podium = Image.new("RGBA", img.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    pod = ImageDraw.Draw(podium, "RGBA")
    polygon(pod, [(455, 496), (630, 452), (840, 490), (653, 552)],
            (26, 41, 66, 243), (61, 234, 242, 236), 5)
    polygon(pod, [(455, 496), (653, 552), (653, 565), (455, 510)],
            (19, 34, 54, 245), (62, 160, 218, 105), 2)
    polygon(pod, [(653, 552), (840, 490), (840, 505), (653, 565)],
            (14, 30, 55, 249), (96, 108, 240, 112), 2)
    pod.ellipse((589, 463, 707, 505), fill=(44, 250, 246, 127))
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, podium.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(17)))
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, podium)

    # Dark vignette keeps the art legible inside the MMRL card.
    overlay = Image.new("RGBA", img.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    od = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay, "RGBA")
    for n in range(80):
        a = round(2.0 * (n / 80))
        od.rectangle((n, n, WIDTH - n, HEIGHT - n), outline=(0, 0, 6, a), width=2)
    img = Image.alpha_composite(img, overlay).convert("RGB")

    # Quiet, legible project identity in the safe bottom-left edge.
    logo = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    try:
        title_font = ImageFont.truetype(
            "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 43)
        subtitle_font = ImageFont.truetype(
            "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 15)
    except OSError:
        title_font = ImageFont.load_default()
        subtitle_font = ImageFont.load_default()
    logo.line([(44, 485), (166, 485)], fill=(45, 221, 240), width=3)
    logo.text((43, 507), "ROOTATLAS", font=title_font,
              fill=(211, 250, 255), stroke_width=1, stroke_fill=(4, 32, 47))
    logo.text((45, 569), "FEDERATED ANDROID ROOT MODULES",
              font=subtitle_font, fill=(113, 209, 232))

    OUTPUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    img.save(OUTPUT, format="JPEG", quality=85, optimize=True, progressive=True,
             subsampling=0)
    print(f"Banner: {OUTPUT}, {WIDTH}x{HEIGHT}, {OUTPUT.stat().st_size} bytes")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`scripts/catalog.py`:

```py
"""Read the exact catalog powering the upstream Best Root Apps website.

The upstream Pages generator parses bold Markdown table rows using APP_ROW.
Do not turn APKs, LSPosed entries, or other apps into root modules.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import re
from collections import Counter
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

SOURCE = "https://github.com/krishna3163/best-root-apps-for-android"
APP_ROW = re.compile(
    r"^\| \*\*\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?://[^)]+)\)\*\* \| (.*?) \| (.*?) \| (.*?) \|\s*$"
)
MARKDOWN_LINK = re.compile(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?://[^)\s]+)\)")
FRAMEWORK_BADGE = re.compile(r"\[(M|K|A|LSP)\]")
HEADING = re.compile(r"^#{2,5}\s+(.+)")
GITHUB_REPO = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+/[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$")
AUTO_START = "<!-- AUTO-DISCOVERED-ROOT-APPS:START -->"
AUTO_END = "<!-- AUTO-DISCOVERED-ROOT-APPS:END -->"
CATEGORY_DEFAULT = "Root Apps"


def provider(url: str) -> str:
    try:
        host = (urlsplit(url).hostname or "").lower()
        if host.startswith("www."):
            host = host[4:]
        return host or "unknown"
    except ValueError:
        return "unknown"


def github_repository(url: str) -> str | None:
    """Return the exact GitHub owner/repo, never a guessed GitHub URL."""
    try:
        parts = urlsplit(url)
        if parts.scheme != "https" or (parts.hostname or "").lower() != "github.com":
            return None
        path = parts.path.strip("/").split("/")
        if len(path) < 2:
            return None
        full = path[0] + "/" + path[1].removesuffix(".git")
        return full if GITHUB_REPO.fullmatch(full) else None
    except ValueError:
        return None


def framework_badges(text: str) -> list[str]:
    mapping = {"M": "Magisk", "K": "KernelSU", "A": "APatch", "LSP": "LSPosed"}
    return [mapping[key] for key in FRAMEWORK_BADGE.findall(text)]


def clean_markdown(text: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", text).strip()


def classify(description: str, category: str, frameworks: list[str], url: str) -> str:
    """Classification is descriptive; only archive inspection authorizes installation."""
    blob = (description + " " + category).lower()
    if "LSPosed" in frameworks and not any(x in frameworks for x in ("Magisk", "KernelSU", "APatch")):
        return "lsposed"
    if any(x in frameworks for x in ("Magisk", "KernelSU", "APatch")):
        return "root_module_candidate"
    if any(s in blob for s in ("shizuku", "rish", "wireless debugging")):
        return "shizuku"
    if any(s in blob for s in ("lsposed", "xposed", "zygisk")):
        return "lsposed_or_zygisk"
    if any(s in blob for s in ("magisk module", "kernelsu module", "apatch module", "root module")):
        return "root_module_candidate"
    if provider(url) == "play.google.com":
        return "android_app"
    return "android_tool"


def item_id(url: str, name: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256((url.lower().rstrip("/") + "|" + name.casefold()).encode()).hexdigest()[:18]


def parse_readme(readme: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Follow the upstream APP_ROW contract, retaining each card and its labels."""
    entries: list[dict] = []
    current_category = CATEGORY_DEFAULT
    auto = False
    for line in readme.splitlines():
        if AUTO_START in line:
            auto = True
            current_category = "Auto-Discovered Root Projects"
            continue
        if AUTO_END in line:
            auto = False
            continue
        h = HEADING.match(line)
        if h and not auto:
            current_category = clean_markdown(h.group(1)).replace("**", "").strip()
        match = APP_ROW.match(line)
        if not match:
            continue
        name, url, description, badge_text, links_text = match.groups()
        category = "Auto-Discovered Root Projects" if auto else current_category
        repo = github_repository(url)
        frameworks = framework_badges(badge_text)
        links = [{"label": label, "url": dest} for label, dest in MARKDOWN_LINK.findall(links_text)]
        entry = {
            "id": item_id(url, name),
            "name": name, "url": url, "description": clean_markdown(description),
            "category": category, "provider": provider(url),
            "frameworks": frameworks, "license": badge_text, "links": links,
            "kind": classify(description, category, frameworks, url),
            "origin": "upstream_readme",
        }
        if repo:
            entry["repository"] = repo
        entries.append(entry)
    if len(entries) < 1000:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Upstream catalog unexpectedly small: {len(entries)}")
    if len({e["id"] for e in entries}) != len(entries):
        raise RuntimeError("Nonunique catalog identifiers; retain source consistency")
    return entries


def parse_morphe(data: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Morphe releases are *APK discovery entries*, never flashable root modules."""
    entries = []
    for slug, record in sorted(data.items()):
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            continue
        tag = record.get("release_tag") or ""
        if not tag or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+", tag):
            continue
        url = SOURCE + "/releases/tag/" + tag
        name = record.get("name") or slug
        entries.append({
            "id": item_id(url, str(name)), "name": str(name), "url": url,
            "description": "Morphe patch: " + ", ".join(record.get("patches", [])[:6]),
            "category": "Morphe Patched APKs", "provider": "github.com",
            "frameworks": [], "license": "See upstream", "links": [
                {"label": "Morphe release", "url": url},
            ], "kind": "patched_apk", "origin": "upstream_morphe",
            "version": str(record.get("version") or ""),
            "package": str(record.get("package_name") or ""),
            "channel": str(record.get("channel") or ""),
            "build_type": str(record.get("build_type") or ""),
        })
    return entries


def parse_trackers(config: dict, seen_repos: set[str]) -> list[dict]:
    """Capture the official tracked sources that aren't in the README tables."""
    entries = []
    for app in config.get("apps", []):
        if not app.get("enabled", True):
            continue
        repository = app.get("repository", "")
        if not GITHUB_REPO.fullmatch(repository) or repository.casefold() in seen_repos:
            continue
        url = "https://github.com/" + repository
        name = app.get("name") or repository
        entries.append({
            "id": item_id(url, name), "name": name, "url": url,
            "description": "Upstream release tracker", "category": "Release Trackers",
            "provider": "github.com", "frameworks": [], "license": "See upstream",
            "links": [], "kind": "tracked_project", "origin": "upstream_config",
            "repository": repository,
        })
        seen_repos.add(repository.casefold())
    return entries


def build_discovery(readme: str, morphe_data: dict, config: dict) -> dict:
    entries = parse_readme(readme)
    seen_repos = {e["repository"].casefold() for e in entries if e.get("repository")}
    entries += parse_morphe(morphe_data)
    entries += parse_trackers(config, seen_repos)
    by_kind = dict(sorted(Counter(e["kind"] for e in entries).items()))
    by_provider = dict(sorted(Counter(e["provider"] for e in entries).items()))
    return {
        "schema_version": 2,
        "source": SOURCE,
        "upstream_website": "https://krishna3163.github.io/best-root-apps-for-android/",
        "summary": {
            "total_entries": len(entries),
            "readme_entries": sum(e["origin"] == "upstream_readme" for e in entries),
            "morphe_entries": sum(e["origin"] == "upstream_morphe" for e in entries),
            "tracker_extras": sum(e["origin"] == "upstream_config" for e in entries),
            "unique_github_repositories": len(seen_repos),
            "by_kind": by_kind, "by_provider": by_provider,
        },
        "entries": entries,
    }

```

`scripts/federation.py`:

```py
"""Federate curated MMRL and KernelSU Next upstream feeds.

Original ZIPs/URLs remain upstream. Never invent timestamps or hide invalid
payloads behind synthetic defaults. Bad modules or failing sources are skipped
without blanking the previously published catalogue.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
import math
import re
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit

SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
MAX_INDEX_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_TRACK = {"UNKNOWN", "ONLINE_JSON", "ONLINE_ZIP", "GIT", "LOCAL_JSON", "LOCAL_ZIP"}
REPO = re.compile(r"^https://github\.com/[A-Za-z0-9-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/?$", re.I)
MODULE_ID = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,180}$")
INT32 = 2_147_483_647
STR_FIELDS = ("description", "homepage", "icon", "cover", "donate", "support", "license", "readme")
LIST_FIELDS = ("categories", "arch", "devices", "screenshots", "require", "permissions")


def https_url(value) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.startswith("https://"):
        return False
    try:
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        return bool(parsed.hostname and not parsed.username and not parsed.password)
    except ValueError:
        return False


def canonical_base(url: str) -> str:
    if not https_url(url):
        raise ValueError("repository must be a public HTTPS URL")
    parsed = urlsplit(url)
    if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
        raise ValueError("repository base cannot include query or fragment")
    path = parsed.path.rstrip("/")
    return urlunsplit(("https", parsed.netloc.lower(), path, "", "")) + "/"


def canonical_github(url: str) -> str | None:
    if not https_url(url):
        return None
    parsed = urlsplit(url)
    if parsed.hostname.casefold() != "github.com" or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
        return None
    parts = parsed.path.strip("/").split("/")
    if len(parts) != 2 or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9-]+", parts[0]):
        return None
    repo = parts[1].removesuffix(".git")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", repo):
        return None
    return f"https://github.com/{parts[0]}/{repo}"


def finite_number(x):
    return type(x) in (float, int) and math.isfinite(x) and x >= 0


def parse_code(value):
    if type(value) is int and 0 <= value <= INT32:
        return value
    return None


def normalize_mmrl(item: dict) -> dict | None:
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        return None
    identifier, name, author = item.get("id"), item.get("name"), item.get("author")
    if not (isinstance(identifier, str) and MODULE_ID.fullmatch(identifier) and
            isinstance(name, str) and 0 < len(name.strip()) <= 220 and
            isinstance(author, str) and 0 < len(author.strip()) <= 220):
        return None
    track = item.get("track")
    if not isinstance(track, dict) or track.get("type") not in ALLOWED_TRACK:
        return None
    added = track.get("added")
    if not finite_number(added):
        added = 0.0
    src = track.get("source")
    trk = {"type": track["type"], "added": float(added),
           "source": src if https_url(src) else ""}
    versions = []
    seen_codes = set()
    for v in item.get("versions") or []:
        if not isinstance(v, dict):
            continue
        code = parse_code(v.get("versionCode"))
        ts = v.get("timestamp")
        url = v.get("zipUrl")
        version = v.get("version")
        if (code is None or not finite_number(ts) or not https_url(url) or
                not isinstance(version, str) or not version.strip()):
            continue
        if code in seen_codes:
            continue
        seen_codes.add(code)
        result = {"versionCode": code, "version": version[:150],
                  "timestamp": float(ts), "zipUrl": url}
        if type(v.get("size")) is int and 0 < v["size"] <= INT32:
            result["size"] = v["size"]
        if isinstance(v.get("changelog"), str):
            result["changelog"] = v["changelog"][:25000]
        versions.append(result)
    if not versions:
        return None
    versions.sort(key=lambda z: (z["versionCode"], z["timestamp"]), reverse=True)
    latest = versions[0]
    mod = {"id": identifier, "name": name.strip()[:220],
           "author": author.strip()[:220], "version": latest["version"],
           "versionCode": latest["versionCode"], "track": trk,
           "versions": versions[:5], "verified": False}
    for field in STR_FIELDS:
        value = item.get(field)
        if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) <= 15000:
            if field in ("homepage", "icon", "cover", "donate", "support", "readme"):
                if not https_url(value):
                    continue
            mod[field] = value
    for field in LIST_FIELDS:
        value = item.get(field)
        if (isinstance(value, list) and len(value) <= 30
                and all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) <= 512 for s in value)):
            mod[field] = value
    for field in ("minApi", "maxApi", "size", "stars"):
        value = item.get(field)
        if type(value) is int and 0 <= value <= INT32:
            mod[field] = value
    return mod


def normalize_ksu(item) -> dict | None:
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        return None
    repo = canonical_github(item.get("repoUrl", ""))
    if not repo:
        return None
    name = item.get("name")
    author = item.get("author")
    description = item.get("description")
    if not all(isinstance(v, str) and 0 < len(v.strip()) <= 1500
               for v in (name, author, description)):
        return None
    if item.get("visibility", 1) != 1:
        return None
    mod = {"name": name.strip()[:250], "description": description.strip()[:1000],
           "author": author.strip()[:250], "repoUrl": repo, "visibility": 1}
    for field in ("bannerUrl", "license"):
        val = item.get(field)
        if field == "bannerUrl" and https_url(val):
            mod[field] = val
        elif field == "license" and isinstance(val, str) and len(val) < 150:
            mod[field] = val
    return mod


def load_curated(path: Path) -> dict:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if data.get("schema_version") != SCHEMA_VERSION:
        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected federation source format")
    return data


def gather_feeds(config: dict, get_json):
    """Get all curated and official-discovery sources; directory failure is soft."""
    mmrl = {canonical_base(url) for url in config["mmrl"]}
    notes = []
    directory = config.get("mmrl_directory")
    if directory:
        try:
            remote = get_json(directory)
            if not isinstance(remote, list):
                raise ValueError("MMRL directory is not an array")
            if len(remote) > 1000:
                raise ValueError("Unexpectedly large public directory")
            mmrl.update(canonical_base(url) for url in remote)
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, RuntimeError) as exc:
            notes.append(f"Official MMRL directory unavailable: {type(exc).__name__}")
    self_base = canonical_base("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge/main/")
    mmrl.discard(self_base)
    ksu = [entry for entry in config["ksunext"] if entry.get("enabled", False)]
    return sorted(mmrl), ksu, notes


def fetch_all(mmrl_urls, ksu_sources, fetch_json, previous, now):
    """Parallel source ingestion; last-good cache is used on fetch/schema failures."""
    tasks = [("mmrl", url, url.rstrip("/") + "/json/modules.json")
             for url in mmrl_urls]
    tasks += [("ksunext", source["name"], source["url"])
              for source in ksu_sources]
    states, failures, fresh, malformed = {}, [], 0, 0

    def job(kind, label, url):
        nonlocal malformed
        data = fetch_json(url)
        if kind == "mmrl":
            if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("modules"), list):
                raise ValueError("Not an MMRL modules index")
            if len(data["modules"]) > 20000:
                raise ValueError("MMRL index exceeds module limit")
            normalized = [v for item in data["modules"]
                          if (v := normalize_mmrl(item)) is not None]
            invalid = len(data["modules"]) - len(normalized)
        else:
            if not isinstance(data, list) or len(data) > 10000:
                raise ValueError("Not a KernelSU Next module array")
            normalized = [v for item in data if (v := normalize_ksu(item)) is not None]
            invalid = len(data) - len(normalized)
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("No valid entries; retaining previous source")
        return {"kind": kind, "source": label, "url": url, "count": len(normalized),
                "invalid": invalid, "last_success": now, "entries": normalized}

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
        future_map = {pool.submit(job, *task): task for task in tasks}
        for fut in as_completed(future_map):
            kind, label, url = future_map[fut]
            key = kind + ":" + url
            try:
                value = fut.result()
                fresh += 1
                malformed += value["invalid"]
                states[key] = value
            except (OSError, ValueError, TimeoutError, RuntimeError, TypeError) as exc:
                old = previous.get("sources", {}).get(key)
                if isinstance(old, dict) and old.get("entries") and old.get("kind") == kind:
                    states[key] = old
                    status = "stale"
                else:
                    status = "excluded"
                failures.append({"kind": kind, "source": label, "status": status,
                                 "error": type(exc).__name__})
    return states, {"fetched": fresh, "failed": len(failures),
                    "malformed_modules": malformed, "failures": failures,
                    "total": len(tasks)}


def merge(base_mmrl: list, base_ksu: list, states: dict):
    """Deduplicate MMRL by ID, KSU Next by GitHub repository URL."""
    chosen = {}
    origins = {}
    conflict_counts = {}
    for base in base_mmrl:
        chosen[base["id"]] = copy.deepcopy(base)
        origins[base["id"]] = {"kind": "catalog", "url": base.get("homepage", "")}
    external = []
    # Curated sources are evaluated before uncurated GitHub discoveries.
    # Automatically discovered repositories must NEVER shadow an existing
    # module ID, even with a forged higher versionCode.
    for key, state in sorted(states.items(), key=lambda pair: (
        1 if pair[1].get("tier") == "discovered" else 0, pair[0])):
        if state.get("kind") != "mmrl":
            continue
        for item in state.get("entries", []):
            external.append((item, state["source"], state.get("tier", "curated")))
    for item, origin, tier in external:
        identifier = item["id"]
        incumbent = chosen.get(identifier)
        if incumbent is None:
            chosen[identifier] = item
            origins[identifier] = {"kind": "mmrl", "url": origin}
            continue
        conflict_counts[identifier] = conflict_counts.get(identifier, 0) + 1
        if tier == "discovered":
            # Do not let a random search result usurp known publishers.
            continue
        # VersionCode is the primary ordering for Android modules; stable
        # ordering means exact ties continue using existing/catalog source.
        if (item["versionCode"], item["versions"][0]["timestamp"]) > (
            incumbent["versionCode"], incumbent["versions"][0]["timestamp"]):
            chosen[identifier] = item
            origins[identifier] = {"kind": "mmrl", "url": origin}
    mmrl = sorted(chosen.values(), key=lambda m: (m["name"].casefold(), m["id"]))
    ksu_map = {canonical_github(m.get("repoUrl", "")) .casefold(): copy.deepcopy(m)
               for m in base_ksu if canonical_github(m.get("repoUrl", ""))}
    ksu_origins = {k: "catalog" for k in ksu_map}
    for key, state in sorted(states.items()):
        if state.get("kind") != "ksunext":
            continue
        for item in state.get("entries", []):
            key_repo = item["repoUrl"].casefold()
            if key_repo not in ksu_map:
                ksu_map[key_repo] = item
                ksu_origins[key_repo] = state["source"]
            else:
                # The official manifest can supply richer nonfunctional metadata.
                for field in ("bannerUrl", "license"):
                    if field in item and field not in ksu_map[key_repo]:
                        ksu_map[key_repo][field] = item[field]
    ksu = sorted(ksu_map.values(), key=lambda m: (m["name"].casefold(), m["repoUrl"]))
    audit = {"module_origins": origins, "module_conflicts": conflict_counts,
             "ksu_origins": ksu_origins}
    return mmrl, ksu, audit


def federate(root: Path, base_mmrl: list, base_ksu: list, request_json, now: int):
    config = load_curated(root / "sources/federation.json")
    old = {}
    state_path = root / "federation-state.json"
    try:
        old = json.loads(state_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):
        pass
    mmrl_urls, ksu_sources, notes = gather_feeds(config, request_json)
    curated_mmrl = set(mmrl_urls)
    curated_ksu = {entry["url"] for entry in ksu_sources}

    try:
        from source_discovery import discover
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        from scripts.source_discovery import discover
    search_state_path = root / "source-discovery-state.json"
    try:
        previous_search = json.loads(search_state_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):
        previous_search = {}
    new_sources, search_state, search_report = discover(
        previous_search,
        lambda url, limit, timeout: request_json(url),
        now,
    )
    for source in new_sources:
        if source["kind"] == "mmrl" and source["url"].endswith("/json/modules.json"):
            mmrl_urls.append(source["url"][:-len("json/modules.json")])
        elif source["kind"] == "ksunext" and source["url"].endswith("/modules.json"):
            ksu_sources.append({"name": source["repository"], "url": source["url"]})
    mmrl_urls = sorted(set(canonical_base(url) for url in mmrl_urls))
    ksu_sources = list({s["url"]: s for s in ksu_sources}.values())

    states, report = fetch_all(mmrl_urls, ksu_sources, request_json, old, now)
    for value in states.values():
        if value["kind"] == "mmrl":
            base = value["url"][:-len("json/modules.json")] if value["url"].endswith("json/modules.json") else ""
            value["tier"] = "curated" if base in curated_mmrl else "discovered"
        elif value["kind"] == "ksunext":
            value["tier"] = "curated" if value["url"] in curated_ksu else "discovered"
    if not states:
        raise RuntimeError("No usable federation sources; preserving existing outputs")
    mmrl, ksu, audit = merge(base_mmrl, base_ksu, states)
    report.update({
        "mmrl_upstream_sources": len(mmrl_urls),
        "ksu_upstream_sources": len(ksu_sources),
        "base_mmrl_modules": len(base_mmrl),
        "base_ksu_modules": len(base_ksu),
        "unified_mmrl_modules": len(mmrl),
        "unified_ksu_modules": len(ksu),
        "mmrl_external_selected": sum(o["kind"] == "mmrl" for o in audit["module_origins"].values()),
        "ksu_external_selected": sum(o != "catalog" for o in audit["ksu_origins"].values()),
        "duplicate_ids_resolved": len(audit["module_conflicts"]),
        "directory_notes": notes,
        "independent_discovery": search_report,
    })
    return (mmrl, ksu, {"schema_version": 1, "generated": now, "sources": states},
            audit, report, search_state)

```

`scripts/source_discovery.py`:

```py
"""Bounded, reproducible discovery of independent Android root-module feeds.

Searches GitHub *repository* metadata only, then probes exact public MMRL
and KernelSU Next JSON contracts. No scraping arbitrary web pages, no
installation, and no wholesale trust of GitHub search results.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import time
import urllib.parse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

SEARCH_QUERIES = (
    "mmrl-repo in:name archived:false fork:false",
    "magisk-module-repo in:name archived:false fork:false",
    "MMRL modules repository in:description archived:false fork:false",
    "magisk modules repository in:description archived:false fork:false",
    "kernelsu modules repo in:description archived:false fork:false",
    "magisk modules mmrl in:readme archived:false fork:false",
)
PROBE_LIMIT = 96  # new repository candidates per run
NEGATIVE_RETRY = 14 * 86400
QUERY_PER_PAGE = 45
MAX_INDEX = 4 * 1024 * 1024
REPOSITORY = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")
VERSION = 1
SELF_REPO = "stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge"
SKIP_NAME_TOKENS = ("template", "example", "demo", "installer_api_test", "gh-repo-clone")



def eligible_repository(full: str) -> bool:
    if not REPOSITORY.fullmatch(full) or full.casefold() == SELF_REPO:
        return False
    name = full.split("/")[-1].lower()
    return not any(token in name for token in SKIP_NAME_TOKENS)


def candidate_urls(repo: dict) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Prefer raw GitHub URLs: they work even when Pages is disabled."""
    full = repo.get("full_name") or ""
    branch = repo.get("default_branch") or "main"
    if not eligible_repository(full) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.\-/]+", branch):
        return []
    owner, name = full.split("/")
    raw = f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{owner}/{name}/{branch}/"
    pages = f"https://{owner.lower()}.github.io/{name}/"
    return [
        ("mmrl", raw + "json/modules.json"),
        ("mmrl", pages + "json/modules.json"),
        ("ksunext", raw + "modules.json"),
        ("ksunext", pages + "modules.json"),
    ]


def inspect_candidate(repo: dict, get_json) -> dict:
    """Accept a candidate only if a real valid module is present."""
    try:
        from federation import normalize_ksu, normalize_mmrl
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        from scripts.federation import normalize_ksu, normalize_mmrl
    last_error = "no_module_index"
    for kind, url in candidate_urls(repo):
        try:
            data = get_json(url, MAX_INDEX, 16)
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, TimeoutError, RuntimeError) as exc:
            last_error = type(exc).__name__
            continue
        if kind == "mmrl":
            if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("modules"), list):
                continue
            if len(data["modules"]) > 10000:
                continue
            valid = sum(normalize_mmrl(item) is not None for item in data["modules"])
        else:
            if not isinstance(data, list) or len(data) > 10000:
                continue
            valid = sum(normalize_ksu(item) is not None for item in data)
        if valid:
            return {"kind": kind, "url": url, "modules": valid,
                    "status": "found", "repository": repo["full_name"]}
    return {"kind": "none", "status": "unmatched", "repository": repo["full_name"],
            "last_error": last_error}


def search_github(get_json, now: int):
    """GitHub search is discovery, not authority; a failed query is non-fatal."""
    repos, errors = {}, []
    # One stable search for exact repo names; rotate broad searches to spread
    # coverage without exhausting GitHub's search-rate quota.
    queries = [SEARCH_QUERIES[0], SEARCH_QUERIES[1]]
    others = SEARCH_QUERIES[2:]
    index = (now // 86400) % len(others)
    queries += [others[index], others[(index + 1) % len(others)]]
    for query in queries:
        # Alternate page 1 and page 2 on successive days.
        for page in (1, 2):
            params = urllib.parse.urlencode({
                "q": query, "sort": "updated", "order": "desc",
                "per_page": QUERY_PER_PAGE, "page": page,
            })
            try:
                response = get_json("https://api.github.com/search/repositories?" + params,
                                    3 * 1024 * 1024, 25)
                if not isinstance(response, dict) or not isinstance(response.get("items"), list):
                    raise ValueError("Unexpected GitHub search result")
                for item in response["items"]:
                    full = item.get("full_name") or ""
                    if (not eligible_repository(full) or item.get("archived") or
                            item.get("fork") or not item.get("default_branch") or
                            item.get("size", 0) == 0):
                        continue
                    repos[full.casefold()] = {
                        "full_name": full, "default_branch": item["default_branch"],
                    }
            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError) as exc:
                errors.append({"query": query, "page": page,
                               "error": type(exc).__name__})
    return repos, errors


def discover(previous: dict, get_json, now: int):
    """Return working new feeds and compact persistent candidate-search state."""
    prior = previous.get("repositories", {}) if previous.get("version") == VERSION else {}
    found, errors = search_github(get_json, now)
    known = {}
    for key, saved in prior.items():
        if not isinstance(saved, dict):
            continue
        repo = saved.get("repository")
        if isinstance(repo, str) and eligible_repository(repo):
            known[key] = saved.copy()
    todo = []
    for key, item in found.items():
        old = known.get(key, {})
        if old.get("status") == "found":
            continue
        if old.get("checked", 0) and now - old["checked"] < NEGATIVE_RETRY:
            continue
        todo.append((key, item))
    todo.sort(key=lambda x: (known.get(x[0], {}).get("checked", 0), x[0]))
    to_check = todo[:PROBE_LIMIT]
    checked = 0
    if to_check:
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
            pending = {pool.submit(inspect_candidate, item, get_json): key
                       for key, item in to_check}
            for future in as_completed(pending):
                key = pending[future]
                try:
                    result = future.result()
                except Exception as exc:  # Never let one candidate block publishing.
                    result = {"status": "error", "kind": "none",
                              "repository": found[key]["full_name"],
                              "last_error": type(exc).__name__}
                result["checked"] = now
                known[key] = result
                checked += 1
    sources = [
        item for item in known.values()
        if item.get("status") == "found" and
        item.get("kind") in ("mmrl", "ksunext") and
        isinstance(item.get("url"), str) and item["url"].startswith("https://")
    ]
    sources.sort(key=lambda x: (x["kind"], x["url"]))
    report = {
        "github_queries": 8, "github_search_errors": errors,
        "github_search_candidates_this_run": len(found),
        "new_candidates_inspected": checked,
        "remaining_unchecked_candidates": len(todo) - checked,
        "candidates_ever_checked": sum("checked" in x for x in known.values()),
        "discovered_feeds": len(sources),
        "discovered_mmrl_feeds": sum(x["kind"] == "mmrl" for x in sources),
        "discovered_ksu_feeds": sum(x["kind"] == "ksunext" for x in sources),
    }
    return sources, {"version": VERSION, "generated": now, "repositories": known}, report

```

`scripts/update.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Maintain conservative MMRL and KernelSU Next indexes for Best Root Apps.

The complete catalog is discovery-only. Installation entries are emitted only
after inspecting official GitHub release ZIPs for a valid root module.prop.
No downloaded code is executed, and no binaries are mirrored.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

try:
    from catalog import build_discovery
except ModuleNotFoundError:  # when imported from the repository root in unit tests
    from scripts.catalog import build_discovery

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = "krishna3163/best-root-apps-for-android"
UPSTREAM = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" + SOURCE + "/main/"
API = "https://api.github.com/"
MAX_MODULE_BYTES = 96 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024
NEW_CHECKS_PER_RUN = 2000
NEGATIVE_RETRY_SECS = 48 * 3600
MAX_WORKERS = 8
BLOCKED_ASSETS = (
    "source", "debug", "symbols", "uninstaller", "uninstall",
    "magisk-manager", "manager-only", "boot.img", "vendor_boot",
)
HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "android-root-feed-bridge/2.0 (+https://github.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge)",
    "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
    "X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
}


def request(url: str, *, limit: int = MAX_SOURCE_BYTES, timeout: int = 25) -> bytes:
    """Read a bounded response (including content-length check before buffering)."""
    if not url.startswith("https://"):
        raise ValueError("Refusing non-HTTPS URL: " + url)
    headers = HEADERS.copy()
    if url.startswith(API) and os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN"):
        headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as response:
        length = response.headers.get("Content-Length")
        if length and int(length) > limit:
            raise ValueError("Response too large: " + url)
        body = response.read(limit + 1)
        if len(body) > limit:
            raise ValueError("Response exceeds maximum allowed size: " + url)
        return body


def read_json(url: str, *, optional: bool = False, limit: int = MAX_SOURCE_BYTES):
    try:
        return json.loads(request(url, limit=limit).decode("utf-8"))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        if optional and exc.code in (404, 410, 422):
            return None
        raise


def json_file(path: Path, default):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):
        return default


def write_json(path: Path, payload):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def source_catalog() -> dict:
    """Use the same README row contract as the upstream website generator."""
    readme = request(UPSTREAM + "README.md", limit=MAX_SOURCE_BYTES).decode("utf-8-sig")
    config = read_json(UPSTREAM + "config/apps.json")
    morphe = read_json(UPSTREAM + "data/morphe-releases.json", optional=True) or {}
    if not isinstance(config, dict) or not isinstance(morphe, dict):
        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected source JSON, refusing to publish")
    return build_discovery(readme, morphe, config)


def release(repo: str):
    return read_json(API + "repos/" + repo + "/releases/latest", optional=True)


def parse_prop(blob: bytes):
    props = {}
    for line in blob.decode("utf-8-sig", "replace").splitlines():
        if "=" in line and not line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
            key, value = line.split("=", 1)
            props[key.strip()] = value.strip()
    code = props.get("versionCode", "")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{1,10}", code) or int(code) > 2_147_483_647:
        return None
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128}", props.get("id", "")):
        return None
    if not props.get("name") or not props.get("version"):
        return None
    return props


def inspect_asset(asset):
    """Statically examine a ZIP. module.prop at ZIP root is mandatory."""
    size = asset.get("size") or 0
    name = (asset.get("name") or "").lower()
    if not (0 < size <= MAX_MODULE_BYTES and name.endswith(".zip")):
        return None
    if any(word in name for word in BLOCKED_ASSETS):
        return None
    url = asset.get("browser_download_url", "")
    if not url.startswith("https://github.com/"):
        return None
    blob = request(url, limit=MAX_MODULE_BYTES, timeout=85)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(blob)) as archive:
            if len(archive.infolist()) > 50_000:
                return None
            path = next((name for name in ("module.prop", "./module.prop")
                         if name in archive.namelist()), None)
            if not path or archive.getinfo(path).file_size > 16_384:
                return None
            return parse_prop(archive.read(path))
    except (zipfile.BadZipFile, RuntimeError, ValueError, OSError):
        return None


def timestamp(date: str) -> int:
    if not date:
        return int(time.time())
    try:
        return int(datetime.fromisoformat(date.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
                   .astimezone(timezone.utc).timestamp())
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError):
        return int(time.time())


def inspect(item: dict, previous: dict):
    """Get current release and inspect ZIP. Don't erase good state on fetch errors."""
    repo = item["repository"]
    now = int(time.time())
    before = previous.copy()
    try:
        rel = release(repo)
        if rel is None:
            return {"checked": now, "release_id": None, "valid": False,
                    "reason": "no_latest_release"}
        rid = rel.get("id")
        if rid is None:
            raise ValueError("release ID missing")
        if before.get("release_id") == rid and "valid" in before:
            before["checked"] = now
            return before
        assets = [a for a in rel.get("assets", []) if
                  (a.get("name") or "").lower().endswith(".zip")]
        found = []
        fetch_errors = 0
        for asset in assets:
            try:
                prop = inspect_asset(asset)
            except (TimeoutError, OSError, ValueError, urllib.error.HTTPError) as exc:
                fetch_errors += 1
                print(f"WARN {repo}/{asset.get('name')}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
                continue
            if prop:
                found.append((asset, prop))
        if not found:
            if fetch_errors:
                before["last_error"] = "asset_download_failed"
                return before
            return {"checked": now, "release_id": rid, "valid": False,
                    "reason": "no_valid_module_zip"}
        # One repo's release can carry different device/arch-specific ZIPs.
        # MMRL can present only one unambiguous module candidate for now.
        # Never arbitrarily pick among multiple different module.prop IDs.
        ids = {props["id"] for _, props in found}
        if len(ids) > 1:
            return {"checked": now, "release_id": rid, "valid": False,
                    "reason": "ambiguous_multiple_module_ids"}
        # Prefer archive explicitly described as universal when multiple valid.
        found.sort(key=lambda pair: (
            0 if "universal" in (pair[0].get("name") or "").lower() else 1,
            pair[0].get("name") or ""))
        asset, prop = found[0]
        date = rel.get("published_at") or rel.get("created_at") or ""
        return {
            "checked": now, "release_id": rid, "valid": True,
            "prop": {k: prop.get(k, "") for k in (
                "id", "name", "version", "versionCode", "author", "description")},
            "zip": asset["browser_download_url"], "zip_count": len(assets),
            "valid_zip_count": len(found), "timestamp": timestamp(date),
            "size": asset.get("size", 0), "asset_name": asset.get("name") or "",
            "reason": "verified_zip_metadata",
        }
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError) as exc:
        print(f"WARN keeping previous state for {repo}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        before["last_error"] = type(exc).__name__
        return before


def collect_repositories(entries: list[dict]):
    """Exactly the unique GitHub repos from catalog and official trackers."""
    repos = {}
    for entry in entries:
        repo = entry.get("repository", "")
        if repo:
            repos.setdefault(repo.casefold(), {
                "repository": repo, "name": entry["name"],
                "description": entry.get("description", ""),
                "frameworks": entry.get("frameworks", []),
            })
    return repos


def create_indexes(discovery: dict, state: dict, now: int):
    repos = collect_repositories(discovery["entries"])
    modules, ksu, seen_ids = [], [], set()
    # Prefer the newest inspected release when forks publish the same
    # module.prop id. MMRL supports one ID per feed; alternative repositories
    # remain individually discoverable in KernelSU Next.
    for key in sorted(repos, key=lambda k: (-state.get(k, {}).get("timestamp", 0), k)):
        item, entry = repos[key], state.get(key, {})
        if not entry.get("valid"):
            continue
        prop = entry.get("prop") or {}
        identifier = prop.get("id")
        if not identifier:
            continue
        code = int(prop["versionCode"])
        url = "https://github.com/" + item["repository"]
        description = (prop.get("description") or item["description"])[:500]
        if not description:
            description = "Root module; inspect upstream source for compatibility."
        # KernelSU Next dedupes by name + repoUrl, not module.prop ID.
        if entry.get("zip_count") == 1 and entry.get("valid_zip_count", 1) == 1:
            ksu.append({
                "name": prop["name"], "description": description[:350],
                "author": prop.get("author") or item["repository"].split("/")[0],
                "repoUrl": url, "visibility": 1,
            })
        if identifier in seen_ids:
            continue
        seen_ids.add(identifier)
        modules.append({
            "id": identifier, "name": prop["name"], "version": prop["version"],
            "versionCode": code,
            "author": prop.get("author") or item["repository"].split("/")[0],
            "description": description, "homepage": url,
            "size": int(entry["size"]), "verified": False,
            "track": {"type": "GIT", "added": float(entry["timestamp"]), "source": url},
            "versions": [{
                "version": prop["version"], "versionCode": code,
                "zipUrl": entry["zip"], "timestamp": float(entry["timestamp"]),
                "size": int(entry["size"]),
            }],
        })
    modules.sort(key=lambda m: (m["name"].casefold(), m["id"]))
    ksu.sort(key=lambda m: (m["name"].casefold(), m["repoUrl"]))
    return modules, ksu


def main():
    discovery = source_catalog()
    now = int(time.time())
    previous_discovery = json_file(ROOT / "discovery.json", {"entries": []})
    old_total = len(previous_discovery.get("entries", []))
    if old_total and len(discovery["entries"]) < old_total * 0.75:
        raise RuntimeError("Upstream catalog shrank >25%; retaining last published files")
    repositories = collect_repositories(discovery["entries"])
    old = json_file(ROOT / "state.json", {"repos": {}}).get("repos", {})
    state = {key: old.get(key, {}) for key in repositories}

    due = []
    for key, item in repositories.items():
        prior = state[key]
        if prior.get("valid") or now - prior.get("checked", 0) >= NEGATIVE_RETRY_SECS:
            due.append((key, item, prior))
    # Check every formerly valid module; then never-before-seen candidates;
    # then oldest negative results. New candidates are never starved.
    due.sort(key=lambda x: (
        0 if x[2].get("valid") else 1 if not x[2] else 2,
        x[2].get("checked", 0),
        x[0],
    ))
    checked_now = due[:NEW_CHECKS_PER_RUN]
    if checked_now:
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=MAX_WORKERS) as pool:
            futures = {pool.submit(inspect, item, previous): key
                       for key, item, previous in checked_now}
            for future in as_completed(futures):
                state[futures[future]] = future.result()

    base_modules, base_ksu = create_indexes(discovery, state, now)
    try:
        from federation import federate
    except ModuleNotFoundError:  # test/import path from the repository root
        from scripts.federation import federate
    modules, ksu, federation_state, federation_audit, federation_report, search_state = federate(
        ROOT, base_modules, base_ksu,
        lambda url: read_json(url, limit=16 * 1024 * 1024), now
    )
    previous_modules = json_file(ROOT / "json/modules.json", {"modules": []}).get("modules", [])
    if not modules:
        raise RuntimeError("Zero valid modules; refusing to publish empty feeds")
    if len(previous_modules) >= 30 and len(modules) < len(previous_modules) * 0.75:
        raise RuntimeError("Verified module count dropped >25%; refusing destructive feed update")
    checked = sum("checked" in state[key] for key in repositories)
    valid = sum(bool(state[key].get("valid")) for key in repositories)
    discovery["updated"] = now
    discovery["summary"].update({
        "repository_candidates": len(repositories),
        "checked_repositories": checked,
        "pending_repositories": len(repositories) - checked,
        "valid_module_repositories": valid,
        "mmrl_modules": len(modules),
        "kernelsu_next_modules": len(ksu),
        "catalog_mmrl_modules": len(base_modules),
        "catalog_kernelsu_next_modules": len(base_ksu),
        "federated_mmrl_sources": federation_report["mmrl_upstream_sources"],
        "federated_ksu_sources": federation_report["ksu_upstream_sources"],
    })
    report = {
        "updated": now, "source": SOURCE,
        "catalog_entries": len(discovery["entries"]),
        "catalog_readme_entries": discovery["summary"]["readme_entries"],
        "morphe_apks": discovery["summary"]["morphe_entries"],
        "tracked_extras": discovery["summary"]["tracker_extras"],
        "github_repositories": len(repositories),
        "checked_repositories": checked,
        "pending_repositories": len(repositories) - checked,
        "checked_this_run": len(checked_now),
        "verified_module_repositories": valid,
        "mmrl_modules": len(modules),
        "kernelsu_next_modules": len(ksu),
        "catalog_mmrl_modules": len(base_modules),
        "catalog_ksu_modules": len(base_ksu),
        "federation": federation_report,
        "exclusions_by_reason": {
            reason: sum(v.get("reason") == reason for v in state.values())
            for reason in sorted({v.get("reason") for v in state.values() if v.get("reason")})
            if reason != "verified_zip_metadata"
        },
    }

    # Stage all serializable outputs in memory before touching disk.
    cover = ("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stupidgiraffe/"
             "android-root-feed-bridge/main/assets/root-feed-banner.jpg")
    mmrl = {
        "name": "RootAtlas — Android Module Index",
        "website": "https://github.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge",
        "cover": cover,
        "description": "RootAtlas unifies independent Android module repositories with transparent provenance and daily sync.",
        "metadata": {"version": 1, "timestamp": float(now)},
        "modules": modules,
    }
    config = {
        "name": mmrl["name"], "website": mmrl["website"],
        "cover": cover, "description": mmrl["description"],
    }
    write_json(ROOT / "json/modules.json", mmrl)
    write_json(ROOT / "json/config.json", config)
    write_json(ROOT / "ksu/modules.json", ksu)
    write_json(ROOT / "discovery.json", discovery)
    write_json(ROOT / "report.json", report)
    write_json(ROOT / "federation-state.json", federation_state)
    write_json(ROOT / "federation-provenance.json", federation_audit)
    write_json(ROOT / "source-discovery-state.json", search_state)
    write_json(ROOT / "state.json", {"schema_version": 2, "generated": now, "repos": state})
    print("RESULT " + json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
