`scripts/validate.py`:

```py
"""Fail-closed contract validation for merged MMRL, KernelSU Next and discovery."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MAX_INT = 2_147_483_647
COVER = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge/main/assets/root-feed-banner.jpg"
TRACK_TYPES = {"GIT", "ONLINE_ZIP", "ONLINE_JSON", "UNKNOWN", "LOCAL_JSON", "LOCAL_ZIP"}


def load(name):
    return json.loads((ROOT / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError("Feed validation failed: " + message)


def https_url(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("https://") and len(value) > 9


def validate():
    mmrl = load("json/modules.json")
    config = load("json/config.json")
    ksu = load("ksu/modules.json")
    discovery = load("discovery.json")
    state = load("state.json")
    report = load("report.json")
    federation_state = load("federation-state.json")
    provenance = load("federation-provenance.json")
    config_sources = load("sources/federation.json")
    search_state = load("source-discovery-state.json")
    require(search_state.get("version") == 1, "independent source-discovery state schema")
    search_repos = search_state.get("repositories")
    require(isinstance(search_repos, dict), "source-discovery repositories missing")
    for key, entry in search_repos.items():
        repo = entry.get("repository", "").casefold()
        require(repo != "stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge",
                "source-discovery must not recursively import RootAtlas")
        require("template" not in repo.split("/")[-1],
                "demo/template repositories must never enter source index")
        if entry.get("status") == "found":
            require(https_url(entry.get("url")),
                    "discovered source must use HTTPS")
            require(entry.get("kind") in ("mmrl", "ksunext"),
                    "unrecognized discovered source type")

    require(mmrl.get("name") == config.get("name"), "MMRL config name mismatch")
    require(mmrl.get("cover") == COVER and config.get("cover") == COVER,
            "MMRL cover missing")
    require((ROOT / "assets/root-feed-banner.jpg").stat().st_size > 5000,
            "banner empty or missing")
    require(mmrl.get("metadata", {}).get("version") == 1, "metadata version")
    require(isinstance(mmrl["metadata"].get("timestamp"), (int, float)),
            "metadata timestamp")
    require(isinstance(mmrl.get("modules"), list) and mmrl["modules"],
            "MMRL missing modules")
    require(isinstance(ksu, list) and ksu, "KSU Next requires nonempty array")
    require(isinstance(federation_state.get("sources"), dict),
            "federation-state missing source cache")
    require(config_sources.get("schema_version") == 1, "federation source schema")
    require(isinstance(provenance.get("module_origins"), dict),
            "missing module provenance")
    require(isinstance(provenance.get("ksu_origins"), dict),
            "missing KSU provenance")

    # Authorization: only module records present in the current trusted
    # federation cache, or previously inspected in the catalog state.
    source_entries = {}
    ksu_entries = {}
    for entry in federation_state["sources"].values():
        if entry.get("kind") == "mmrl":
            base = entry.get("source")
            if not https_url(base):
                continue
            source_entries[base] = {(m["id"], m["versionCode"], m["versions"][0]["zipUrl"])
                                    for m in entry.get("entries", [])}
        elif entry.get("kind") == "ksunext":
            source = entry.get("source")
            ksu_entries[source] = {m["repoUrl"].casefold()
                                   for m in entry.get("entries", [])}

    seen, original = set(), 0
    for module in mmrl["modules"]:
        module_id = module.get("id")
        require(isinstance(module_id, str) and module_id and module_id not in seen,
                f"duplicate/invalid MMRL module {module_id}")
        seen.add(module_id)
        for key in ("id", "name", "author", "version", "versionCode", "track", "versions"):
            require(module.get(key) is not None, f"{module_id} missing {key}")
        require(all(isinstance(module[k], str) and bool(module[k])
                    for k in ("name", "author", "version")), f"{module_id}: name/author/version")
        code = module["versionCode"]
        require(type(code) is int and 0 <= code <= MAX_INT,
                f"{module_id}: invalid versionCode")
        track = module["track"]
        require(isinstance(track, dict) and track.get("type") in TRACK_TYPES,
                f"{module_id}: track type")
        require(isinstance(track.get("source"), str), f"{module_id}: track.source")
        versions = module["versions"]
        require(isinstance(versions, list) and len(versions) >= 1,
                f"{module_id}: no versions")
        for ver in versions:
            require(isinstance(ver, dict), f"{module_id}: invalid version entry")
            for key in ("version", "versionCode", "zipUrl", "timestamp"):
                require(key in ver and ver[key] is not None,
                        f"{module_id}: versions missing {key}")
            require(type(ver["versionCode"]) is int and 0 <= ver["versionCode"] <= MAX_INT,
                    f"{module_id}: version entry code")
            require(isinstance(ver["version"], str) and ver["version"],
                    f"{module_id}: version entry title")
            require(https_url(ver["zipUrl"]), f"{module_id}: insecure zipUrl")
            require(type(ver["timestamp"]) in (int, float) and
                    math.isfinite(ver["timestamp"]) and ver["timestamp"] >= 0,
                    f"{module_id}: invalid version timestamp")
        require(versions[0]["versionCode"] == code and
                versions[0]["version"] == module["version"],
                f"{module_id}: top-level version mismatch")

        origin = provenance["module_origins"].get(module_id)
        require(isinstance(origin, dict), f"{module_id}: missing provenance")
        zip_url = versions[0]["zipUrl"]
        if origin.get("kind") == "catalog":
            original += 1
            source = track["source"]
            require(source.startswith("https://github.com/"),
                    f"{module_id}: verified origin not GitHub")
            repo_key = source.removeprefix("https://github.com/").casefold()
            saved = state.get("repos", {}).get(repo_key, {})
            require(saved.get("valid") is True and saved.get("zip") == zip_url,
                    f"{module_id}: catalog provenance not backed by inspected ZIP")
        elif origin.get("kind") == "mmrl":
            source = origin.get("url")
            require(source in source_entries, f"{module_id}: unapproved federation source")
            require((module_id, code, zip_url) in source_entries[source],
                    f"{module_id}: origin absent from normalized source index")
        else:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{module_id}: unknown origin category")

    require(len(provenance["module_origins"]) == len(mmrl["modules"]),
            "MMRL provenance count mismatch")
    require(len(ksu) == len({m.get("repoUrl", "").casefold() for m in ksu}),
            "duplicate KernelSU GitHub repository")
    for module in ksu:
        repo = module.get("repoUrl")
        require(https_url(repo) and repo.startswith("https://github.com/"),
                "KSU source must be a GitHub repo")
        require(all(isinstance(module.get(key), str) and module[key].strip()
                    for key in ("name", "author", "description")),
                f"KSU entry incomplete: {repo}")
        require(module.get("visibility") == 1, f"KSU hidden item included: {repo}")
        key = repo.casefold()
        source = provenance["ksu_origins"].get(key)
        require(source is not None, f"KSU missing provenance: {repo}")
        if source == "catalog":
            state_key = repo.removeprefix("https://github.com/").casefold()
            entry = state.get("repos", {}).get(state_key, {})
            require(entry.get("valid") is True and entry.get("zip_count") == 1,
                    f"KSU catalog source not archive inspected: {repo}")
        else:
            require(key in ksu_entries.get(source, set()),
                    f"KSU source absent from official upstream list: {repo}")

    require(discovery.get("schema_version") == 2, "discovery schema")
    entries = discovery.get("entries")
    require(isinstance(entries, list) and len(entries) >= 1000,
            "original discovery catalog lost")
    require(len({e["id"] for e in entries}) == len(entries),
            "duplicate catalog ID")
    require(any(e["provider"] == "codeberg.org" for e in entries), "lost Codeberg projects")
    require(any(e["provider"] == "gitlab.com" for e in entries), "lost GitLab projects")
    require(any(e["kind"] == "patched_apk" for e in entries), "lost Morphe APKs")
    require(discovery["summary"]["total_entries"] == len(entries), "discovery count mismatch")
    require(report.get("catalog_entries") == len(entries), "reported discovery count mismatch")
    require(report.get("mmrl_modules") == len(mmrl["modules"]),
            "reported MMRL count mismatch")
    require(report.get("kernelsu_next_modules") == len(ksu),
            "reported KernelSU count mismatch")
    require(report.get("checked_repositories") <= report.get("github_repositories"),
            "catalog coverage mismatch")
    federation_report = report.get("federation", {})
    discovered_count = sum(entry.get("status") == "found" for entry in search_repos.values())
    require(federation_report.get("independent_discovery", {}).get("discovered_feeds")
            == discovered_count, "discovered source count mismatch")
    require(federation_report.get("unified_mmrl_modules") == len(mmrl["modules"]),
            "federation MMRL count mismatch")
    require(federation_report.get("unified_ksu_modules") == len(ksu),
            "federation KSU count mismatch")
    require(federation_report.get("base_mmrl_modules", 0) >= 200,
            "base catalog mysteriously shrank")
    require(federation_report.get("base_ksu_modules", 0) >= 100,
            "base KernelSU catalog mysteriously shrank")
    print(f"Validated federated feeds: {len(mmrl['modules'])} MMRL, "
          f"{len(ksu)} KernelSU Next, {len(entries)} discovery entries, "
          f"{len(federation_state['sources'])} cached upstream sources, "
          f"{original} MMRL entries from inspected catalog")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    validate()

```

`tests/test_catalog.py`:

```py
"""Regression tests for complete catalog and conservative dual-feed generation."""
import importlib.util
import pathlib
import unittest

from scripts.catalog import build_discovery, parse_readme, provider, github_repository

PATH = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts/update.py"
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("bridge_update", PATH)
feed = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(feed)


def row(name, url, desc="", badges="See project"):
    return f"| **[{name}]({url})** | {desc} | {badges} | [Source]({url}) |"


class CatalogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_upstream_row_contract_categorization_and_non_github(self):
        from scripts.catalog import classify, framework_badges
        self.assertEqual(classify("Works with Shizuku", "Tools", [], "https://github.com/a/b"), "shizuku")
        self.assertEqual(classify("An LSPosed module", "Tools", ["LSPosed"], "https://codeberg.org/a/b"), "lsposed")
        self.assertEqual(classify("KernelSU module", "Tools", ["KernelSU"], "https://github.com/a/b"), "root_module_candidate")
        self.assertEqual(framework_badges("FOSS [M] [K] [LSP]"), ["Magisk", "KernelSU", "LSPosed"])

    def test_all_entries_preserved(self):
        text = "\n".join(["<!-- AUTO-DISCOVERED-ROOT-APPS:START -->"] + [
            row(f"App {i}", f"https://github.com/user/repo{i}", "Shizuku app")
            for i in range(1002)
        ]) + "\n<!-- AUTO-DISCOVERED-ROOT-APPS:END -->\n" + row(
            "Non-GitHub", "https://codeberg.org/owner/app", "standalone application")
        result = build_discovery(text, {
            "patched": {"name": "Patched APK", "release_tag": "patched-v1",
                        "version": "v1", "patches": ["Feature"]}
        }, {"apps": [
            {"name": "Tracker", "repository": "example/upstream-new", "enabled": True}
        ]})
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["readme_entries"], 1003)
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["morphe_entries"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["tracker_extras"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["entries"]), 1005)
        self.assertTrue(any(x["provider"] == "codeberg.org" for x in result["entries"]))
        self.assertTrue(any(x["kind"] == "patched_apk" for x in result["entries"]))

    def test_repo_url_canonicalization(self):
        self.assertEqual(github_repository("https://github.com/Owner/repo/releases/latest"), "Owner/repo")
        self.assertEqual(github_repository("https://github.com/Owner/repo.git"), "Owner/repo")
        self.assertIsNone(github_repository("https://gitlab.com/Owner/repo"))
        self.assertEqual(provider("https://codeberg.org/o/r"), "codeberg.org")

    def test_kernel_su_feed_cannot_select_multiple_zip_releases(self):
        data = {"entries": [
            {"repository": "a/b", "name": "Example", "description": "",
             "frameworks": ["KernelSU"]},
            {"repository": "c/d", "name": "APK", "description": "", "frameworks": []},
        ]}
        entry = {"valid": True, "prop": {"id": "module", "name": "Example",
                    "version": "v1", "versionCode": "1", "author": "Author",
                    "description": ""}, "size": 1024, "zip": "https://github.com/a/b/releases/download/v1/abc.zip",
                 "zip_count": 2, "valid_zip_count": 1, "timestamp": 1000}
        modules, ksu = feed.create_indexes(data, {"a/b": entry}, 1000)
        self.assertEqual(len(modules), 1)
        self.assertEqual(ksu, [])
        entry["zip_count"] = 1
        modules, ksu = feed.create_indexes(data, {"a/b": entry}, 1000)
        self.assertEqual(len(ksu), 1)

    def test_same_id_forks_are_not_lost_in_kernel_su(self):
        entries = {"entries": [
            {"repository": "older/module", "name": "Older", "description": ""},
            {"repository": "newer/module", "name": "Newer", "description": ""},
        ]}
        def state(repo, time):
            return {"valid": True, "prop": {"id": "shared.id", "name": repo,
                    "version": "1", "versionCode": "1", "author": "Author",
                    "description": "Example"}, "size": 100,
                    "zip": f"https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/v1/m.zip",
                    "zip_count": 1, "valid_zip_count": 1, "timestamp": time}
        modules, ksu = feed.create_indexes(entries, {
            "older/module": state("older/module", 100),
            "newer/module": state("newer/module", 200),
        }, 1000)
        self.assertEqual(len(modules), 1)
        self.assertEqual(modules[0]["homepage"], "https://github.com/newer/module")
        self.assertEqual(len(ksu), 2)

    def test_cached_release_checked_timestamp_is_updated(self):
        saved = {"valid": True, "release_id": 55, "checked": 1, "prop": {"id": "t"}}
        original = feed.release
        feed.release = lambda repo: {"id": 55}
        try:
            result = feed.inspect({"repository": "a/b"}, saved)
        finally:
            feed.release = original
        self.assertTrue(result["checked"] > 1)
        self.assertTrue(result["valid"])
        self.assertEqual(result["prop"]["id"], "t")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_federation.py`:

```py
"""Unit tests for federated source validation, caching and duplicate handling."""
import unittest

from scripts.federation import (
    canonical_base, canonical_github, gather_feeds, normalize_mmrl,
    normalize_ksu, fetch_all, merge,
)


def module(mid="sample", code=12, timestamp=123.0):
    return {
        "id": mid, "name": "Sample", "author": "Test", "version": "1",
        "versionCode": code,
        "track": {"type": "ONLINE_JSON", "added": timestamp, "source": ""},
        "versions": [{"version": "1", "versionCode": code, "timestamp": timestamp,
                      "zipUrl": "https://github.com/author/a/releases/download/1/m.zip"}],
    }


class FederationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_source_dedup_and_self_exclusion(self):
        config = {
            "mmrl": ["https://example.org/repo", "https://example.org/repo//",
                     "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge/main/"],
            "mmrl_directory": "https://example.org/list.json",
            "ksunext": [{"name": "official", "url": "https://example.org/ksu.json",
                         "enabled": True},
                        {"name": "nonfree", "url": "https://example.org/nonfree",
                         "enabled": False}],
        }
        m, k, warnings = gather_feeds(config, lambda url: ["https://other.org/r/"])
        self.assertEqual(m, ["https://example.org/repo/", "https://other.org/r/"])
        self.assertEqual(len(k), 1)
        self.assertEqual(warnings, [])

    def test_invalid_timestamp_does_not_break_index(self):
        bad = module()
        bad["versions"] = [{"version": "2", "versionCode": 2,
                            "zipUrl": "https://example.org/module.zip"}]
        self.assertIsNone(normalize_mmrl(bad))
        bad["versions"].append(module()["versions"][0])
        good = normalize_mmrl(bad)
        self.assertEqual(len(good["versions"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(good["versionCode"], 12)

    def test_type_and_url_checks(self):
        self.assertIsNone(normalize_mmrl({**module(), "track": {"type": "WRONG"}}))
        self.assertIsNone(normalize_mmrl({**module(), "versions": [{"version":"1",
                           "versionCode":1,"timestamp":1,"zipUrl":"http://insecure"}]}))
        self.assertIsNone(normalize_ksu({"name":"x","author":"y","description":"z",
                                        "repoUrl":"https://example.org/malware"}))
        self.assertEqual(canonical_github("https://github.com/OWNER/repo/"),
                         "https://github.com/OWNER/repo")
        self.assertEqual(canonical_base("https://example.org/r////"), "https://example.org/r/")

    def test_cache_fallback(self):
        source = "https://example.org/repo/"
        url = source + "json/modules.json"
        previous = {"sources": {"mmrl:" + url: {
            "kind": "mmrl", "source": source, "url": url,
            "count": 1, "invalid": 0, "last_success": 100,
            "entries": [normalize_mmrl(module())]}}}
        def broken(_):
            raise OSError("Source temporarily unavailable")
        states, status = fetch_all([source], [], broken, previous, 200)
        self.assertEqual(status["failed"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(status["failures"][0]["status"], "stale")
        self.assertEqual(len(states["mmrl:" + url]["entries"]), 1)

    def test_merge_dedup_and_prioritize_newer(self):
        catalog = module("shared", 9, 100)
        catalog["track"]["source"] = "https://github.com/original/a"
        remote = normalize_mmrl(module("shared", 12, 200))
        extra = normalize_mmrl(module("only-remote", 1, 90))
        state = {"mmrl:https://remote.test/r/json/modules.json": {
            "kind":"mmrl", "source":"https://remote.test/r/",
            "entries":[remote, extra]}}
        base_ksu = [{"name": "One", "author": "A", "description": "b",
                     "repoUrl": "https://github.com/original/a", "visibility": 1}]
        state["ksunext:https://official.test/all.json"] = {
            "kind":"ksunext", "source":"Official", "entries":[
                {"name":"Same","author":"B","description":"c",
                 "repoUrl":"https://github.com/ORIGINAL/a","visibility":1,
                 "license":"GPL-3.0"},
                {"name":"More","author":"B","description":"c",
                 "repoUrl":"https://github.com/new/r","visibility":1},
            ]}
        m, k, audit = merge([catalog], base_ksu, state)
        self.assertEqual(len(m), 2)
        self.assertEqual(next(i for i in m if i["id"] == "shared")["versionCode"], 12)
        self.assertEqual(audit["module_origins"]["shared"]["kind"], "mmrl")
        self.assertEqual(audit["module_conflicts"]["shared"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(k), 2)
        self.assertEqual(next(i for i in k if i["repoUrl"].lower().endswith("/a"))["license"],
                         "GPL-3.0")

    def test_discovered_malicious_version_cannot_shadow_catalog(self):
        catalog = module("unique.module", 4, 50)
        original_zip = catalog["versions"][0]["zipUrl"]
        forged = normalize_mmrl(module("unique.module", 2_147_483_647, 200))
        state = {"mmrl:https://unknown.test/json/modules.json": {
            "kind": "mmrl", "source": "https://unknown.test/",
            "tier": "discovered", "entries": [forged]}}
        modules, _, audit = merge([catalog], [], state)
        self.assertEqual(len(modules), 1)
        self.assertEqual(modules[0]["versionCode"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(modules[0]["versions"][0]["zipUrl"], original_zip)
        self.assertEqual(audit["module_origins"]["unique.module"]["kind"], "catalog")

    def test_bad_index_refuses_empty_source(self):
        base = "https://example.org/"
        def fetch(_):
            return {"name":"Broken","modules":[{"id":"broken"}]}
        states, status = fetch_all([base], [], fetch, {}, 100)
        self.assertEqual(states, {})
        self.assertEqual(status["failures"][0]["status"], "excluded")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_source_discovery.py`:

```py
"""Bounded discovery tests: no unverified feeds or unsafe URLs enter RootAtlas."""
import unittest

from scripts.source_discovery import candidate_urls, inspect_candidate, discover, PROBE_LIMIT


class DiscoveryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_candidate_paths_and_identity(self):
        good = {"full_name": "Example/MMRL-Repo", "default_branch": "main"}
        links = candidate_urls(good)
        self.assertEqual(len(links), 4)
        self.assertEqual(links[0], ("mmrl", "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Example/MMRL-Repo/main/json/modules.json"))
        self.assertTrue(all(u.startswith("https://") for _, u in links))
        self.assertEqual(candidate_urls({"full_name": "../../bad", "default_branch": "main"}), [])

    def test_never_index_ourselves_or_repository_templates(self):
        from scripts.source_discovery import eligible_repository
        self.assertFalse(eligible_repository("stupidgiraffe/android-root-feed-bridge"))
        self.assertFalse(eligible_repository("MMRLApp/template-repository"))
        self.assertFalse(eligible_repository("somebody/mmrl-example"))
        self.assertTrue(eligible_repository("uonou/mmrl-repo"))

    def test_only_valid_mmrl_indices_are_accepted(self):
        item = {"full_name": "Example/MMRL-Repo", "default_branch": "main"}
        good = {
            "name": "Example Feed",
            "modules": [{
                "id": "example", "name": "Example", "author": "Author",
                "version": "1", "versionCode": 1,
                "track": {"type": "GIT", "source": "https://github.com/Example/Module"},
                "versions": [{
                    "version": "1", "versionCode": 1, "timestamp": 1.0,
                    "zipUrl": "https://github.com/Example/Module/releases/download/v1/m.zip",
                }],
            }]
        }
        def fetch(url, limit, timeout):
            if url.endswith("/json/modules.json"):
                return good
            raise OSError("unexpected")
        result = inspect_candidate(item, fetch)
        self.assertEqual(result["kind"], "mmrl")
        self.assertEqual(result["modules"], 1)

    def test_empty_or_malformed_repo_is_not_accepted(self):
        item = {"full_name": "Example/MMRL-Repo", "default_branch": "main"}
        def fetch(url, limit, timeout):
            return {"name": "Looks valid", "modules": [{"id": "bad"}]}
        result = inspect_candidate(item, fetch)
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "unmatched")

    def test_search_no_results_preserves_previous_discoveries(self):
        now = 1_800_000_000
        previous = {"version": 1, "repositories": {
            "author/repo": {
                "status": "found", "repository": "author/repo",
                "kind": "mmrl", "url": "https://author.github.io/repo/json/modules.json",
                "checked": now - 86400,
            },
        }}
        def fetch(url, limit, timeout):
            self.assertIn("/search/repositories", url)
            return {"items": []}
        sources, state, report = discover(previous, fetch, now)
        self.assertEqual(len(sources), 1)
        self.assertEqual(state["version"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(report["new_candidates_inspected"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(report["discovered_mmrl_feeds"], 1)

    def test_github_search_errors_are_nonfatal(self):
        def broken(url, limit, timeout):
            raise OSError("GitHub unavailable")
        sources, state, report = discover({}, broken, 1_800_000_000)
        self.assertEqual(sources, [])
        self.assertEqual(len(report["github_search_errors"]), 8)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_update.py`:

```py
import io
import importlib.util
import pathlib
import unittest
import zipfile

path = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts/update.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("feed_update", path)
feed = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(feed)

class FeedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_prop(self):
        data = b"id=test.mod\nname=Test\nversion=v1\nversionCode=42\nauthor=A\n"
        self.assertEqual(feed.parse_prop(data)["versionCode"], "42")
        self.assertIsNone(feed.parse_prop(data.replace(b"42", b"broken")))
        self.assertIsNone(feed.parse_prop(data.replace(b"test.mod", b"bad id")))

    def test_zip_inspection(self):
        for inner, expected in [("module.prop", True), ("other/module.prop", False)]:
            out = io.BytesIO()
            with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w") as archive:
                archive.writestr(inner, "id=example\nname=Example\nversion=1\nversionCode=1\n")
            original = feed.request
            feed.request = lambda *args, **kwargs: out.getvalue()
            try:
                result = feed.inspect_asset({
                    "name": "module.zip", "size": len(out.getvalue()),
                    "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/a/b/releases/download/v1/module.zip"
                })
                self.assertEqual(bool(result), expected)
            finally:
                feed.request = original

    def test_reject_nonmodules(self):
        self.assertIsNone(feed.inspect_asset({
            "name": "module.apk", "size": 2, "browser_download_url": "https://github.com/a/b"
        }))
        self.assertIsNone(feed.inspect_asset({
            "name": "module.zip", "size": 2, "browser_download_url": "https://untrusted.test/module.zip"
        }))

```
